[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# One thread only: the fault is the order the spawns give, and stealing
# the second child onto another thread would hide it.
env GOMAXPROCS=1

cd replay

# The linter accepts the order the spawns give: the channel carries the
# order, and no memory is raced.
logos lint ./...
! stderr .

# Without a shake the child the group started last runs first and takes
# the lock twice before the other child sends, so the order holds and
# the monitor stays silent.
logos conc test -count=1 ./ord
stdout '^ok '
! stderr .
logos conc run ./ord
stdout '^locked,direct$'
! stderr .

# With shake seed 1 the lock taker yields at its start and at each
# acquire, so the direct child sends first and the test fails. The
# command prints the seed that replays the schedule.
! logos conc test -shake=1 -count=1 ./ord
stdout 'order = '
stderr 'shake seed 1'

# A replay with that printed seed fails the same way.
! logos conc test -shake=1 -count=1 ./ord
stdout 'order = '
stderr 'shake seed 1'

# The space form carries the same seed and fails the same way.
! logos conc test -shake 1 -count=1 ./ord
stdout 'order = '
stderr 'shake seed 1'

# The same schedule fault shows in run, and a replay with that printed
# seed fails the same way.
! logos conc run -shake=1 ./ord
stdout '^direct,locked$'
stderr 'shake seed 1'
! logos conc run -shake=1 ./ord
stdout '^direct,locked$'
stderr 'shake seed 1'

-- replay/go.mod --
module example.com/shakereplay

go 1.27
-- replay/ord/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"logos/sync"
)

type box struct{ n int }

var gate sync.Locked[box]

func locked(first chan string) error {
	gate.WithLock(b => {
		b.n++
	})
	gate.WithLock(b => {
		b.n++
	})
	select {
	case first <- "locked":
	default:
	}
	return nil
}

func direct(first chan string) error {
	select {
	case first <- "direct":
	default:
	}
	return nil
}

func order(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	first := make(chan string, 2)
	go group (ctx) {
		go direct(first)
		go locked(first)
	}
	a := <-first
	b := <-first
	return a + "," + b, nil
}

func main() {
	got, err := order(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(got)
	if got != "locked,direct" {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}
-- replay/ord/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestOrder(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := order(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	if got != "locked,direct" {
		t.Fatalf("order = %q, want %q", got, "locked,direct")
	}
}

func TestBothRan(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := order(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	if got != "locked,direct" && got != "direct,locked" {
		t.Fatalf("order = %q, want both children to send", got)
	}
}
